scope: Retired FluidGenie historical Vast experiments, primarily the pre-repair FM0/CR0/CR1 campaigns. Current repaired models/data remain protected.
execution_vs_science: Runner SUCCESS only means successful execution; it does not mean a scientific gate passed. Infrastructure/workload failures do not establish a negative research result.
historical_protocol_limit: Old episode-0..12 evaluations overlapped training data and do not establish unseen-data generalization. Their metrics are not matched controls for the repaired protocol.

fm0.conclusion: Old FM0 setup was overactive and poorly calibrated; sampling controls did not solve recurrent overactivity. This is not a verdict against the later repaired flow-matching model.

cr0_cr1.conclusion: Bounded recurrent models improved historical short-horizon behavior, but long-horizon physical drift remained. Evaluated episodes overlapped training data.

noise_k8.conclusion: Neither tested configuration met the original frozen long-horizon improvement gate. Their combination was not justified.

physics_screen.conclusion: P1 energy and P3 nominal divergence penalties were harmful under the old protocol. P2 nominal showed initial promise without meeting the strict long-horizon gate. These were training-overlap evaluations.

p2_replication.conclusion: Historical P2 replication was incomplete/inconsistent and its cause unresolved. Preserve that uncertainty; current repaired P2 results are a separate experiment.

retirement_scope: The reviewed historical cache bulk was retired after preservation verification. Current repaired datasets/models and final-result artifacts remain protected. Exact old model/dataset replay requires regeneration/retraining.
configuration_coverage_note: 19 saved-result configurations and one captured current-model input configuration are preserved. The archive also contains evaluation-only sampling sweeps and a physics control, which are not additional training configurations. Missing historical seed-2 replication results are not reconstructed or treated as scientific failures.
evidence_access_note: The public metric summary contains aggregate/scalar findings. Full original compact records and exact source recovery are in the local Git-ignored private archive.

later_experiment_records.scope: Retained separately; old configuration was negative, while its dataset is still used by the current model.
